PR-2887 opened (TASK-2300): https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/2887

Head 167012ce0a0771cdf4c04ec654c3cede012ecff9, branch codex/task-2300. Implements the approved default-origin failure fallback plus folded TASK-1840 (formerly TASK-1-471), tests and plan/release-note correction. TASK-2053 stays Completed; no host clone pool.

Targeted seat_clone::tests:32 passed/0 failed. Subsequent test-only change adds cfg(unix) to the shell timeout regression, leaving Linux compiled behavior unchanged. Final make check-ci-fast:34/34. Gates ran before the ceremony cleanly rebased to current main; CI and independent review remain pending on pushed head. Three spawned author-checker passes, final no further confirmed findings, no author verdict.

Important edge: an explicit --path using the reserved aida-seat-* clone location cannot host a linked worktree; an origin failure there refuses before worktree allocation and asks to drop --path or choose an ordinary worktree path. Automatic default fallback works; explicit seat_tree=clone remains refusal. Failed clone and pin cleanup must both succeed before fallback. Full detail and test evidence are in the PR body and TASK-2300 comment.

Opened with aida ship TASK-2300 --no-merge; not merged.
